name: The Ringer
objective: Stake out the bell tower at midnight and catch whoever is ringing the sixth bell.
intro: The tower stairs are worn in the middle, from thirty years of the same climb. At the top, an old woman holds the rope with both hands.
dialogue: The Midnight Ringer: "It rings at midnight because that is when it listens hardest."
The Midnight Ringer (defeated): "I rang it to keep it asleep. Every night. For thirty years. And you're welcome."
lore_discovery: The Midnight Ringer is the last keeper of an older order than the Echo Cult: ringing the sixth bell alone, once a night, keeps the creature beneath Frostpine dreaming. The Ringer is dying. The ringings have become irregular.
